Watch How it WorksTry App

Learning is still better on paper.

Technology has changed learning, but paper still gives students a simple, focused way to write, solve and show their thinking.

Writing by hand can deepen engagement and memory, while paper removes screen distractions during assessment. Smart Paper preserves these benefits.

Less time checking, more time teaching

Smart Paper reduces grading workload with handwriting recognition, AI-assisted assessment and organized assessment data allowing teachers to focus on teaching, reviewing learning and planning lessons.

Three steps.
One paper-based workflow.

Create your first quiz

1. Create your assessment.

Create the assessment for students with questions, answers, and criteria.

2. Scan the completed papers.

Capture student work with a phone and process papers. SmartPaper digitizes responses.

3. Review. Understand. Act.

Review responses, explore assessment data, and identify patterns.
